name: Personal Agentic OS
summary: A harness for coding agents on one laptop: guard and trace hooks, a bounded DAG runner with typed failures and resume, and verification agents. Built on Claude Code.
shows: Systems design for AI-native engineering; safety and observability; 36 tests.

name: JavaServerClientAPI → Gameholic
summary: An event-driven TCP library for Java and the multiplayer game platform built as its first user.
shows: API design driven by a real consumer; honest trade-offs; tests added in 2026.

name: graphicsAI 3D Editor
summary: A browser-based 3D scene editor in three.js: primitives, lights, cameras, transform tools, OBJ import/export and a procedural particle galaxy. Part of the graphicsAI team project.
shows: Real-time graphics architecture (property-controller pattern), teamwork via PRs, CI deploy. The project's AI image-segmentation service was built by teammate mkjodhani.

name: The Odyssey Voyage
summary: A procedural 3D sailing world with wind physics and star navigation. An unofficial fan tribute.
shows: Simulation modelling, tested TypeScript, AI-assisted workflow.

name: threepp
summary: A small npm package extending three.js with dat.gui scene controls.
